args.summary: After the v2.3.1 deployment, checkout-api began failing health checks (error rate 0.18). The service was rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all production regions. The first rollback attempt partially failed (only us-east updated); a retry completed the rollout to us-west and eu-west. Post-rollback status is healthy across all regions with an error rate of 0.002. v2.3.1 remains quarantined; investigate before any redeploy.

trace.final:
All done. Summary of actions:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back**: First rollback attempt partially failed (only us-east updated, error rate was 0.18 with mixed versions). Retried and completed the rollout — **all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on v2.3.0 and healthy**, error rate down to 0.002.
3. **Opened incident**: SEV2 incident **INC-0001** created and on-call paged, documenting the failed deploy, the partial-then-completed rollback, and current healthy status. The first incident creation call timed out, so I retried with an idempotency key to ensure no duplicate incident was created.

Recommendation: keep v2.3.1 quarantined and investigate the root cause before attempting any redeploy.
